title: SKIN-AJA
description: ML-powered skin disease detection API with backend integration and GCP deployment
longDescription: Bangkit Academy capstone project. Developed 6-10 REST API endpoints using Node.js, Express.js, and Firebase. Integrated backend with ML model and mobile application. Deployed complete system on Google Cloud Platform with full testing coverage.

title: BPOM Data Automation
description: Python automation application for pharmaceutical import/export data validation
longDescription: Developed Python application to automate data validation and comparison for 1000+ import/export records. Replaced manual process with automated system, improving speed and accuracy. Integrated with Excel for data processing and reporting.

title: Kelurahan Rejosari Website
description: Laravel-based public service website with admin dashboard and automated services
longDescription: Full-stack development for Semarang kelurahan (village) website. Built using Laravel MVC framework with MySQL database. Features include news management, letter service automation, budget visualization, and public information dissemination. Implemented comprehensive testing across all features.

title: E-Commerce Keripik Tempe UMKM
description: Full-stack e-commerce platform for UMKM tempe chips business
longDescription: End-to-end e-commerce solution for local UMKM business. Features product catalog, inventory management, shopping cart, order processing, and basic payment integration. Designed to help small business reach online market.

title: KaonangStore React
description: Modern React-based digital product catalog with responsive design
longDescription: Modern frontend application built with React.js for showcasing digital products. Implements responsive design patterns, component-based architecture, and smooth user interactions. Demonstrates proficiency in contemporary frontend frameworks.

title: Poliklinik Management System
description: PHP-based clinic management system with patient and doctor database
longDescription: Full-featured clinic management system built with PHP and MySQL. Includes patient record management, doctor scheduling, appointment system, and medical records. Demonstrates database design, system architecture, and comprehensive feature implementation.
